source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: Add +1 to [Hit](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls) for melee attacks from this unit. Against its [Slayer’s Oath](vsdata:ability/space-wolves.ulrik-the-slayer.slayers-oath) target they gain +1 to [Wound](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls) as well, with a single +1 to [Hit](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls).

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 10 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.
